title: EE31002: Power Systems
text:

Introduction to Power systems Ã¢ÂÂ Generation, Transmission and distribution
system. Single line diagram and per unit system. Restructuring of power utility
and its implications.Power system components: Circuit model of synchronous
generators and Transformers. Transmission lines Ã¢ÂÂ lumped and distributed
parameter models.Steady state operation Ã¢ÂÂ Short, medium and long line models
of transmission lines. ABCD parameters. Real and reactive power flow on a
transmission line and line loadability.Power Flow Analysis Ã¢ÂÂ Power flow
equations, and solution methods Ã¢ÂÂ Gauss-Seidel, Newton-Raphson and Fast
decoupled load flow algorithms.Faults in Power System Ã¢ÂÂ Short circuits and
open circuits. Symmetrical and Unsymmetrical faults. Symmetrical components and
sequence networks. Analysis of symmetrical and unsymmetrical faults.Power
System Protection Ã¢ÂÂ Protective relays and their characteristics. Overcurrent, distance and differential protection schemes. Circuit breakers.Power
System Controls Ã¢ÂÂ Generator voltage control. Turbine-governor control. Load
Frequency control. Economic dispatch and optimal power flow.Power System
Stability Ã¢ÂÂ Swing equation. Equal area criterion and numerical integration
of swing equation.
